body: Patrol (real P keybind, PACKET_ARENA_PATROL, walks A<->B forever with arrival-triggered direction flip and opportunistic engagement) is the fourth and last slice. Combined with Stop/Attack-move/Hold Position (all shipped earlier today), Milestone 2 of the WC3 unit-control northstar is complete: Tyler's drag-selected clone group now has the full real command vocabulary (move/attack/attack-move/hold/patrol/stop), all sharing one arena_owner_controls-authorized surface and 'a new command always wins' convention. arena_find_opportunistic_target factored out of arena_tick_attack_move once patrol needed the same scan a third time. 13 new tests total across the four commands. Full suite + 10-bot stability green at every step. Commit e7e0467.
title: NORTHSTAR §24 Milestone 2 FULLY SHIPPED: all four WC3 group-order commands
